name: Shinjou Aira
source: The student president. Half-western and half-Japanese. She is prideful and determined, and has earned much admiration for others. She is usually seen as the perfect student, but is surprisingly clumsy in her personal life. She usually does not discriminate against men, but she has a few biased views against them.
